author: KaknuSF
title: Addictively fun on purpose
content:
This game is fun, I can not tell a lie. That being said, they take you to some high highs and then they follow it with some lows that are so low you want to break your phone. I am a level headed person and find myself calm cool and collected even in emergency situations. For the first time in my adult life I have had to coach my breathing and remind myself that this game is designed to do this. Take you high, then take you low, so low in fact you will spend money to get out of it. This makers of this game will force you to be stuck on a level, for hours or days even. And right as you are almost going to finally pass said level, you’ll notice that you’ve cleared all except one of the items needed to conplete the level. Then you’ll start it again and this loop will continue for seemingly ever. They don’t even need to admit it but it’s by design. They want your money. So I’ve stopped double clicking my side button to approve a purchase and I just close the game and come back later. If that happens to be two days, so be it. But do not allow yourself to stress because they have designed it this way. Alcohol, drugs, gambling, these games follow suit: get you hooked and then play on your addiction in hopes that you’ll empty your wallet. 

The game is wicked fun when they aren’t d*cking you around. Remember when you just bought a game and you didn’t have to buy extras to finish that game. The game was sold as is, complete with everything needed to finish the game. This era we live in is all about the excessive intrusive ads and getting more and more of your money.

author: !T $!
title: Addictive, Somewhat Fun, Designed to Cheat You
content: The game is fun and engaging. For the first 1k levels you can pretty much breeze through, with lots of coin earning chances to help you with the tough levels and tons of power ups. Then the big power up, a spotted ball that does double damage, comes in at some point. And the levels just drop away. After 1k the algorithm changes. The levels that aren’t labeled “Hard” become hidden traps. For a time each level will require you to spend coins to get a 5 move add-on, just so you can get the one or two moves you need to clear the level with out loosing the streak, which will take away the “Double Tap” as I like to call it. Then there are the x2 rewards. You will find that you lose those levels as well a lot of the time. You will get runs of 25, 50, or even 100 levels straight without losing. It makes you happy and you get “hook” on the win. Then on a regular level, you start losing, you burn through all the powers up, and coins just to keep the levels going. Then when you are out of means to keep it going, there will be 20 to 40 straight losses on one level. This is to trigger you purchase a pack. Get more coins, because there was only “one” move needed to beat it. And the longer you play that level without a purchase, the worse the loss is. You won’t even clear half of it at times. They change the drop rate of pieces that will create power ups or give a power up but will not allow a linking power up to be created next to the big one for the super combo. Then when you haven’t purchased but start to stay away for longer times, they make it easy again so you don’t “rage quit”. Make you happy and maybe they work you down to make that 1st purchase. I hate this game and the mind game the developers play, but I have ADHD, and it scratches an itch. Good luck, and don’t spend! Don’t make them happy while they hurt you!

author: Queenie_babee
title: A loyal player
content:
I've played Royal Match for years and have spoken highly of it to everyone I know I've personally invited friends and family to join my team, and I lead a great one. That loyalty is exactly why this recent change to the Lightning Match round is so disappointing.
The game presents it as though you're getting free play when it's announced. You're not. I contacted support and spoke with a rep named Emily and then Andrew who confirmed it only resets your complimentary time 24 hours later. That is not what the game implies in the moment, and it doesn't match how this feature used to work. Call it what it is:  MISLEADING!! 
On top of that, there's no reward whatsoever for referring people to the game or building a team — something plenty of other games get right. I've brought in real players and gotten nothing for it.
I don't want to walk away from a team I've built and led for years, but I will if this is the direction the game is heading. There are thousands of other games out there, and I'd rather start over somewhere fair than keep supporting something that misleads its most loyal players.  I’m so disappointed.

title: Can’t really win for free
content: This game used to be so fun. I downloaded it again because of Fetch. But when you get to a certain point you cannot move forward without paying for tools. I’m saving money which is why I use Fetch. I have played the same board (255 Super Hard) multiple times and there is no way to pass it without additional tools. Why not sell a subscription for the game if you need money. I understand making money by selling upgrades but the game should be able to be played and won without spending money. Not everyone has money to throw away. I really love playing this game, love all the top tier graphics but it’s so frustrating. Just offer a subscription already.
